**2h**

This session I really worked on how the board is going to look like. It is going to be a gift for my friend so the functionality is like this: 5/6 keys are for, w, a, s, d, and space because he plays minecraft parkour, and there is going to be one AMAZING and special key, with a special keycap for it, that does absolutely nothing other than making a number on the LED screen go up(screen will display the amount of clicks) so essentially a cookie clicker

### 2026-10-29: So, as I started writing my firmware I decided that it would be funnier if I just make it a really really advanced cookie clicker and that's exactly what I did. after 5000 clicks, button on the top ri

**2h**

So, as I started writing my firmware I decided that it would be funnier if I just make it a really really advanced cookie clicker and that's exactly what I did. after 5000 clicks, button on the top right, next to the top left special key will be unlocked. middle left button will be the gamble button, starting amount at 100 clicks, the two on the bottom is to adjust the gambling amount (+100), (-100), while middle right button is confirming the gamble. there is a random chance(50/50) chance you double or nothing. GL. p.s started the github repo too
